name: Import A2A Agent
description: Import a standard A2A endpoint or a Covia agent as an immutable agent Asset, with a mutable user binding at w/a2a/agents/<name>. Authentication is configured once as a SecretStore reference and never supplied on individual A2A calls.

url.description: Base URL of a standard external A2A agent. Use exactly one of url or coviaAgent.

coviaAgent.description: Covia grid agent address: local g/<agentId> or full <ownerDID>/g/<agentId>. Requires venue.

venue.description: Base URL of the Covia venue hosting coviaAgent. Required for a remote/full address; a local g/<agentId> defaults to this venue's configured baseUrl.

auth.description: Optional stored authentication binding. Use {scheme:<Agent Card scheme name>, secret:'s/NAME'} for card-declared API key or Bearer auth, or {kind:'bearer', secret:'s/NAME'} when Bearer is needed to discover a private card. Literal credentials are not accepted.

output.description: The immutable asset DID URL, mutable workspace binding, and exact agent asset hash.
